children: Lithuania organic food producer's H1 revenue fell yr/yr, mainly on lower milk prices and harvest volume
Company H1 EBITDA and gross profit declined compared to previous year
Company completed Baltic Champs sale, used proceeds to redeem debt and cut liabilities
Company says crop segment results depend on final harvest outcome
LOWER MILK PRICES AND HARVEST VOLUME - Co said H1 revenue decline was mainly due to 19% lower raw milk prices and smaller harvest volume
CROP VALUATION ASSUMPTIONS - Improved crop segment result attributed to more favourable crop valuation assumptions
FMCG SEGMENT - Co said FMCG segment revenue and gross profit grew, helped by lower segment costs
